name: The Cupid
description:
Cupid is the god of desire, erotic love, attraction and affection in classical Roman mythology. A person who is shot by Cupid's arrow is filled with uncontrollable desire and has no other choice but falling in love.

Behind this is a certain belief in fate, the assumption that people have no free will, but are helplessly at the mercy of the play of the gods.  On the other hand, it also provides a good excuse when people fall in love with someone they had better not fall in love with.
